title.zh: 将东内格罗斯省坦哈伊市圣何塞描笼涯奥迪翁甘小学的名称变更为Egmidio V. Manzo纪念小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Odiongan Elementary School in Barangay San Jose, City of Tanjay, Province of Negros Oriental to Egmidio V. Manzo Memorial Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Odiongan Elementary School in Barangay San Jose, City of Tanjay, Province of Negros Oriental to Egmidio V. Manzo Memorial Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Odiongan tại Barangay San Jose, Thành phố Tanjay, Tỉnh Negros Oriental thành Trường tiểu học Egmidio V. Manzo Memorial
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Odiongan ในบารังไกย์ San Jose, เมือง Tanjay, จังหวัด Negros Oriental เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Egmidio V. Manzo Memorial
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Odiongan di Barangay San Jose, Kota Tanjay, Provinsi Negros Oriental menjadi Sekolah Dasar Egmidio V. Manzo Memorial
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Odiongan di Barangay San Jose, Bandaraya Tanjay, Wilayah Negros Oriental menjadi Sekolah Rendah Egmidio V. Manzo Memorial

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2007/ra_9455_2007.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Renaming of Elementary School. - The name of Odiongan Elementary School in Barangay San Jose, City of Tanjay, Province of Negros Oriental is hereby changed to Egmidio V. Manzo Memorial Elementary School.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
